verdict.rationale: Foreloop documents strong review/approval mechanisms (contract approval gate, automated PR reviews with P0/P1/P2 findings, advisory checks) which cover the 'review' part of the story, but there is no explicit documentation of versioning skills/task-contracts or rolling back an automation once executed. Missing for 10: explicit skill/task-contract version history, a rollback or revert mechanism for executed automations, and any UI/CLI for comparing or reverting prior automation versions.
